name: Dayfaro
original_description: Turn source text into podcast scripts and audio with Dayfaro. Create news briefings, explainers, interviews, and conversations with up to four speakers. Choose from English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, and Portuguese, select voices, and add custom instructions. Review and edit scripts before generating audio, follow generation progress, and listen with a transcript directly in ChatGPT. You can also reopen podcasts saved to your connected Dayfaro account. Requires a Dayfaro account with existing credits. Dayfaro uses supplied text by default. Optional Online search beta researches a topic or reads public URLs before writing, and includes source links. Research uses account credits and is off by default. Dayfaro does not schedule recurring episodes itself.
